symptom: Legacy proof tracks remain electrically clean after canonical footprints move or change pad geometry, but no longer prove the projected production PCB.
rootCause: Routing regeneration consumed historical endpoint coordinates and treated occupancy as advisory; transformed pad copper was not authoritative collision geometry.
solution: Parse placed KiCad pads after canonical projection, derive net endpoint trees from their board coordinates, model every projected pad as same-net-aware occupancy, discard proof copper during full regeneration, and write only a candidate PCB for KiCad DRC promotion.
